# Germany

Region: Europe. Sources verified 2026-10-11. Scope follows source documentation, not assumed nationwide CAMT availability.

## Country / regional references

### Deutsche Bundesbank

**Role:** Central bank; account servicer and customer test centre

**Reporting coverage:** Cash-handling accounts of banks; central-bank participant examples, not universal commercial customer profile

**Messages / versions:** camt.052.001.08; camt.053.001.08

- [Customer test centre downloads](https://www.bundesbank.de/de/aufgaben/unbarer-zahlungsverkehr/serviceangebot/kundentestzentrum/kundentestzentrum-602786) — availability; public-page
- [Usage terms](https://www.bundesbank.de/de/startseite/benutzerhinweise/benutzerhinweise-642874?index=2) — availability; public-page

The publisher’s 29 October 2024 SWIFT/EBICS archives were retrieved on 2026-10-11; hashes are recorded in source-inventory.json. There are 22 XML originals, including five with missing element namespaces. Originals are retained unchanged. Terms permit unchanged reproduction, storage and forwarding for personal/business use with the attribution “Quelle: Deutsche Bundesbank”.

### Die Deutsche Kreditwirtschaft (DK), published through EBICS.de/SIZ

**Role:** Banking-community payload-format standard publisher; EBICS also maintains separate transport standard

**Reporting coverage:** Detailed national account-information rules and illustrative XML

**Messages / versions:** camt.052.001.08; camt.053.001.08; camt.054.001.08; camt.086.001.02

- [Current Anlage 3 data-format specification v3.9](https://www.ebics.de/de/datenformate/gueltige-version) — specification; public-page
- [Supplementary schemas, July2025 CAMT examples and mapping](https://www.ebics.de/de/datenformate/ergaenzende-dokumente) — specification; public-page
- [EBICS transport standard (separate from payload)](https://www.ebics.de/de/ebics-standard) — availability; public-page

Supplementary page Chapter7 explicitly provides original ISO2019 CAMT schemas, camt053 complete example and camt054 collection breakdown, XLSX rules and GVC/BTC mapping. Download links use expiring signed securedl URLs; use stable landing. Chapter12 separately covers camt086 bank charges. Footer all rights reserved.
